correctness.rationale: A chord between the jth and kth heptagon vertices has normal angle pi(j+k)/7 modulo pi, yielding exactly 14 signed normal rays; support is 1 at even indices and c=cos(pi/7) at odd ones. Moving any enclosing side inward until support cannot increase area. A bounded four-normal intersection requires all four cyclic gaps to be 1..6, giving exactly 511 subsets. For an active four-line polygon, the edge-length identity A=sum_[adjacent i,j](h_i h_j-(h_i²+h_j²) cos(delta_ij)/2)/sin(delta_ij) follows from intersections and 2A=sum h_i*edge_length_i. Redundant lines produce enclosing triangles with area >=3 sqrt(3)c²>4.05, while winners have area <3.5. The actual bundled exact-rational certificate was reconstituted byte-for-byte from inspected source (Git blob 559efa2bd82951909169b86a6d9ca25a530183b0) and executed successfully: interval Machin pi bounds, Taylor remainder enclosures, 511 exhaustive four-normal values, exactly seven all-odd gap-(2,4,4,4) winning sets, all other 504 formal values > winner+1/40, and 1.2588<ratio<1.2589. Independent 70-digit direct half-plane intersection/shoelace enumeration separately found 511 bounded patterns, seven active winners, seven redundant triangles, normalized winner ratio 1.2588037735470042164 and minimum actual alternative margin 0.02594731998604824>0.025. Winners circumscribe the heptagon inball of radius c with angle gaps 2pi/7,4pi/7,4pi/7,4pi/7; tangential polygon area gives c²(tan(pi/7)+3tan(2pi/7)). The normal-gap configurations form exactly one orbit of seven under dihedral symmetry; affine maps preserve inclusion/parallelism and area ratio. The high-precision numerical experiment alone is not an exact proof; the independent reading of the rational bounds and the original exact certificate establish the finite inequalities.
residual_risks: The discrete 1/40 area gap is only among support-saturated finite directions; there is no continuous perturbation stability theorem.
Reliance on standard circumscribed triangle inequality and elementary support-line area identity, verified analytically not formally in Lean.

value.rationale: The exact chord-constrained quadrilateral area of a regular heptagon is a natural geometric invariant in the new chord conjecture, not an arbitrary subtable. For the first odd vertex count after the settled pentagon case, an exact value and complete optimizer orbit offer a rigorous benchmark for future extremal methods; the >1/40 discrete gap identifies a structural separation of competing permitted tangent configurations. The numeric value was already known approximately, so mathematical value rests on exact proof, equality and rigor, not the decimal itself or a claimed general polygon theorem.
residual_risks: This is one fixed regular-polygon family plus affine images, not a broad stability or global conjecture result.
The lower-bound certificate depends on complete case accounting; independent numerical geometry confirms enumeration but is not a second formal exact proof.

limitations: Only the chord-constrained area for regular heptagon and its affine images; no general arbitrary-polygon theorem.
The strict 1/40 separation is finite-pattern-only; lines slightly moved outward may have arbitrarily small area difference.
Originality is qualified: Vigh already reports the 1.2588 numerical value and older exact tables may exist unindexed.
Public metadata was sanitized in two guarded complete-file operations before staging; this ready plan is not a publication.
